query:
insert into scheduled_drafts (firm_id, client_id, period, slot, ordinal, message_id, created_at, source)
               select $1, $2, $3, $4, count(*)::smallint, $5, $6, $8
               from scheduled_drafts where client_id = $2 and period = $3
               having count(*) < $7
               on conflict do nothing
               returning 1 as "recorded!"
